compiled_state.title: Add llm-api-call.sh deletion notice and document no-compat-wrapper decision
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: The release notes for the version that ships this epic include an explicit deprecation note for `llm-api-call.sh`, naming the replacement Python entry-point and the deprecation window for any compat wrapper added.
- Decision documentation: Document that no compat wrapper was created (story e596 deleted the script directly; S7 compat-wrapper removal is N/A).

## Context
`llm-api-call.sh` was hard-deleted in story e596. No CHANGELOG.md exists in the repo root. The release process uses `scripts/release.sh` which cuts a git tag. The story DD requires a \"deprecation note\" — interpreted as: a deletion notice noting what was removed and what replaced it (since the file is already gone, this is a migration-complete notice, not a forward-looking deprecation).

## Files to Change / Create
- `CHANGELOG.md` at repo root (create if absent): Add an entry for the current epic (migration to Python module) that includes:
  - **Breaking change**: `llm-api-call.sh` has been deleted. The CI LLM review runner is now implemented as `python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner`. Callers must update CI pipelines to invoke `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` (shim) or directly invoke `python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner`.
  - **No compat wrapper**: A thin compat wrapper was considered but not created — the script was deleted directly. S7 (compat-wrapper removal) is a no-op.
  - **Replacement**: `plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh` is the entry point (29-line shim); the real implementation is `dso_ci_review.runner` Python module.

## Implementation Steps
1. Check if `CHANGELOG.md` exists at repo root. If not, create it with standard Keep a Changelog structure.
2. Add an `## [Unreleased]` section (or a versioned section if the release script stamps a version) with a `### Removed` entry for `llm-api-call.sh` and a `### Changed` entry for the CI runner migration.
3. Include clear guidance for out-of-tree consumers: they must update any direct `llm-api-call.sh` invocations to use the shim or Python module directly.
4. Note the no-compat-wrapper decision explicitly so S7 implementers know the removal task is already done.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md exists at repo root
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md contains a notice about llm-api-call.sh removal
  Verify: grep -q "llm-api-call" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md references the Python module replacement
  Verify: grep -q "dso_ci_review" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md documents the no-compat-wrapper decision
  Verify: grep -qi "compat\|wrapper" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CHANGELOG.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
